sentences.en: For giraffes, the thorny acacia leaves are a feast.
sentences.zh: 对于长颈鹿来说，带刺的金合欢树叶就是一顿盛宴。

sentences.en: Thorny as they are, brambles give blackberries.
sentences.zh: 虽然荆棘丛生，但黑莓依然生长其中。

sentences.en: Tom brought up a very thorny subject during the barbecue.
sentences.zh: 汤姆在烧烤会上提出了一个非常棘手的话题。

senses.zh: 多刺的；痛苦的；令人苦恼的
